ety.text: Learned borrowing from Sanskrit असुन्दर (asundara). By surface analysis, अ- (a-) + सुंदर (sundar).

s.g: "Black letters and a buffalo are alike"; for an illiterate person, black letters and a buffalo both convey no meaning; illiteracy renders writing meaningless
